follow the rules: Everyone in the swimming pool must follow the rules, so nobody is allowed to run or push others near the water.
游泳池裡的每個人都必須遵守規定，所以不准任何人在水邊奔跑或推擠他人。
follow one's dream: Although her parents wanted her to become a doctor, Mia decided to follow her dream of becoming a professional dancer.
雖然父母希望她當醫生，蜜雅還是決定追夢，成為一名職業舞者。
follow a career: Like his father and grandfather before him, Kevin plans to follow a career in medicine after he graduates from college.
就像他的父親和祖父一樣，凱文打算大學畢業後從事醫療職業。
follow suit: When one convenience store lowered its coffee prices, the other stores on the street quickly followed suit to keep their customers.
一家便利商店調降咖啡價格後，同一條街上的其他商店也迅速跟進，以留住顧客。
follow up on: The manager promised to follow up on my complaint and call me back with an answer by Friday afternoon.
經理答應會追蹤我的投訴，並在星期五下午前回電給我答覆。
it follows that: All of the students who passed the test studied hard, but it follows that not everyone who studied hard passed.
所有通過考試的學生都很用功，但由此可知，並非每個用功的人都通過了。
follow one's heart: When choosing a major, you should follow your heart and pick something you really love instead of what others expect.
選擇主修時，你應該跟隨內心，挑選自己真正熱愛的，而不是別人期望的。
forbid smoking: Most restaurants in Taiwan forbid smoking indoors, so smokers have to go outside if they want a cigarette.
台灣大多數餐廳禁止室內吸菸，所以吸菸者想抽菸就得到外面去。
be forbidden to enter: Visitors are forbidden to enter the laboratory without permission because some of the chemicals inside are very dangerous.
未經許可，訪客禁止進入實驗室，因為裡面有些化學物品非常危險。
heaven forbid: We should pack a first-aid kit for the hiking trip, just in case someone gets hurt, heaven forbid.
我們應該為登山行程準備急救箱，以防萬一有人受傷——但願不會發生。
forbidden fruit: For many teenagers, video games become forbidden fruit when parents ban them, which only makes them more attractive.
對許多青少年來說，父母一禁止，電玩就成了禁果，反而讓它們更有吸引力。
force a smile: Even though she felt terrible about losing the final, the young player tried to force a smile for the cameras.
雖然輸掉決賽讓她非常難過，這位年輕選手還是在鏡頭前勉強一笑。
force the issue: The two companies had argued for months, so the judge decided to force the issue and demanded a decision by Monday.
這兩家公司已爭執數月，所以法官決定逼迫做決定，要求他們在週一前做出決議。
force one's way: The firefighter forced his way through the thick smoke and broken furniture to rescue the child trapped inside.
消防員硬闖過濃煙和破損的家具，救出受困屋內的孩子。
force a door open: After losing his keys, my uncle called a locksmith because he did not want to force a door open and break it.
我叔叔弄丟鑰匙後找了鎖匠，因為他不想強行開門而把門弄壞。
force someone to resign: The scandal about the missing money was so serious that it forced the company's president to resign last week.
公款失蹤的醜聞非常嚴重，上週逼迫公司總裁辭職。
force one's hand: The reporters kept asking about his plans, trying to force his hand before he was ready to announce anything.
記者們不停追問他的計畫，想在他準備好宣布任何事之前逼迫他表態。
forecast rain: The weather bureau forecasts rain for the whole weekend, so we should move the class picnic to next Saturday.
氣象局預報整個週末都有雨，所以我們應該把班級野餐延到下週六。
forecast growth: Experts forecast growth of about three percent for Taiwan's economy next year, thanks to strong demand for computer chips.
由於電腦晶片需求強勁，專家預測台灣明年經濟成長約百分之三。
forecast the result: Before the votes were counted, few people could forecast the result of such a close election with any confidence.
開票前，很少有人能有把握地預測這場勢均力敵的選舉結果。
forge a friendship: During the two-week summer camp, students from different countries forged a friendship that lasted for many years.
在為期兩週的夏令營中，來自不同國家的學生建立了延續多年的友誼。
forge ahead: Despite the heavy rain and strong wind, the climbers decided to forge ahead and reach the top before dark.
儘管風雨交加，登山者仍決定奮力前進，在天黑前登頂。
forge a signature: The boy copied his father's handwriting to forge a signature on his poor report card, but the teacher noticed immediately.
男孩模仿父親的筆跡，在成績差的成績單上偽造簽名，但老師馬上就發現了。
forge an alliance: The two small parties decided to forge an alliance so that together they could win more seats in the election.
這兩個小黨決定結盟，以便聯手在選舉中贏得更多席次。
forge links: The exchange program aims to forge links between high schools in Taiwan and Japan through visits and online classes.
這個交流計畫旨在透過參訪和線上課程，在台灣與日本的高中之間建立連結。
form a habit: Experts say it takes about two months to form a habit, such as going to bed early or exercising every day.
專家說，養成一個習慣大約需要兩個月，例如早睡或每天運動。
form an opinion: Before you form an opinion about the new student, you should spend some time getting to know her.
在你對那位新同學形成看法之前，應該先花點時間認識她。
form a government: After winning most of the seats in the election, the party was asked by the king to form a government.
在選舉中贏得多數席次後，該黨受國王之邀組閣。
form a line: When the bus arrived, the passengers formed a line at the door instead of pushing to get on first.
公車到站時，乘客們在門口排隊，而不是推擠著搶先上車。
form the basis of: The results of this survey will form the basis of our school's new plan to reduce plastic waste.
這項調查的結果將構成本校減少塑膠垃圾新計畫的基礎。
form a band: Jason and three of his classmates decided to form a band and play their own songs at the school festival.
傑森和三位同學決定組樂團，在校慶上演奏他們自己創作的歌曲。
